links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses on adenoid hypertrophy versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: No model met the recommended sixth-grade reading level; Gemini best (FRES 61.95±9.64), Copilot poorest (FRES 24.27±10.77); P<0.001.
links.quote: All models failed to meet the recommended sixth-grade readability thresholds.

links.outcome: Reading level of LLM-generated patient information versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: No model met the sixth-grade reading level; FRES ranged from 24.27±10.77 (Copilot) to 61.95±9.64 (Gemini).
links.quote: No model met the recommended sixth-grade reading level.

links.outcome: Source transparency/attribution of chatbot responses via JAMA benchmarks
links.effect: Only Copilot and Perplexity scored 1 point on JAMA benchmarks; other models scored lower.
links.quote: Only Copilot and Perplexity scored 1 point on JAMA benchmarks.

screen.reason: Evaluates the reliability and readability of patient-facing information generated by five public LLM chatbots on adenoid hypertrophy FAQs without testing a specific organizational deployment practice.
